hooks.command: git fetch --quiet --prune origin 2>/dev/null; for b in develop main; do behind=$(git rev-list --count "$b..origin/$b" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$behind" ] && [ "$behind" -gt 0 ]; then echo "⚠ Local $b is $behind commit(s) behind origin/$b — pull/rebase before editing (hot files: schema.prisma, queries.ts)"; fi; done; gone=$(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short) %(upstream:track)' refs/heads | awk '$2=="[gone]" {printf "%s ", $1}'); [ -n "$gone" ] && echo "⚠ Local branches whose remote branch is gone: ${gone}— check git log origin/develop..<branch> for unmerged work before git branch -D"; extra=$(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:lstrip=3)' refs/remotes/origin | grep -vxE 'HEAD|develop|main' | tr '\n' ' '); [ -n "$extra" ] && echo "ℹ Remote branches besides develop and main: ${extra}— delete each once its work has landed or been dropped, with the user's approval"; true
hooks.statusMessage: Checking origin for new commits and stale branches
